name: Aider
description: Pair-programming tool that edits code in local git repos via LLM; supports whole-file and diff-based edits, multi-model rotation, and Git commit automation.
notable_features: architect+editor dual-model mode (strong model plans, weak model edits)
repo-map to give the LLM context about the entire codebase
search/replace edit blocks (same edit-block format FlexFactor adopted)
multi-provider rotation: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex
voice input support
built-in linter integration and auto-fix loop

ideas.why_valuable: Using a frontier model to plan changes and a cheaper model to apply them reduces cost while preserving output quality.
Giving the LLM a summarised map of the whole repo (function signatures, class hierarchy) before per-file review reduces hallucinations about cross-file dependencies.

name: SWE-agent
description: Autonomous agent that applies LLMs to resolve GitHub issues end-to-end; uses ACI (agent-computer interface) to read/write/run code in a container.
notable_features: structured action space (view, scroll, edit, run) prevents free-text hallucinations
dockerised sandbox for safe execution of arbitrary commands
scored against SWE-bench; highest open-source resolution rate at release
multi-file patch generation
configurable LLM backend

ideas.why_valuable: Running untrusted generated code in an isolated container prevents host-system side-effects and enables safe test execution.
ideas.purpose_reason: FlexFactor targets Windows desktop repos where Docker is not always present; the existing subprocess policy gate is the safety boundary.

name: Cursor
description: AI-first fork of VS Code with native multi-model support, Composer agent mode, and inline chat; integrates Cursor Tab (autocomplete) alongside larger models.
notable_features: Composer: multi-step agentic code generation across multiple files
pool-first model rotation: uses the best available model from subscription
.cursor/rules for project-specific system-prompt injection
background agents running in isolated machines
YOLO mode: auto-run terminal commands without confirmation

ideas.why_valuable: A project-local rules file that is automatically prepended to every review/fix prompt would let owners customise FlexFactor's behaviour per-repo without modifying the tool.

name: Devin (Cognition)
description: Fully autonomous software engineer agent; plans multi-step tasks, runs a terminal, writes and tests code, and reports back; SaaS model with web UI.
notable_features: long-horizon planning with sub-task decomposition
integrated browser for research
snapshot/restore of agent state for resumable sessions
PR creation and review response built-in
parallel task execution across multiple machines

ideas.idea_title: Sub-task decomposition for large repair runs
ideas.why_valuable: Breaking a multi-hundred-file audit into goal-aligned sub-tasks lets the LLM maintain coherent intent across more files than a single context window allows.

name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
description: Open-source autonomous coding agent with a browser UI, sandboxed runtime, and a pluggable agent framework; competes with Devin on open benchmarks.
notable_features: pluggable agent backends (CodeAct, SWE-agent, monologue, etc.)
sandboxed execution via Docker microVM
GitHub issue → PR pipeline
multi-LLM backend support via LiteLLM
evaluation harness against SWE-bench, WebArena

ideas.why_valuable: A single thin adapter layer that translates any provider's API to the OpenAI chat-completion format lets FlexFactor add new providers (Gemini, Bedrock, Mistral) without per-provider code.
